I take women’s rights seriously, so this is one of the first things I asked about while visiting Ghardaïa, Algeria  Now this is not necessarily for any reason. It has nothing to do with religion or location. The only thing it has to do with is that many communities that are small and follow old traditions typically give less rights and protections to women. However, I was pleasantly surprised that this is not the case in Ghardaia.   I really appreciate what I learned about  Mozabite communities, giving women in their own committees and ability to make decisions for themselves. When it comes to dress, extra protections, to feel safe and comfortable in their marriages, and the community standing in solidarity with its women. Did you know the original Tarzan was filmed in Algeria? 🇩🇿🌴 This is the Jardin d’Essai du Hamma in Algiers; one of the most incredible botanical gardens I’ve ever visited. It was created in 1832 as an experimental garden, where plants from around the world were introduced and tested to see what could grow in Algeria’s climate. Today, the garden is a huge green oasis in the middle of Algiers. And in 1932, this jungle like setting became the location where the original Tarzan was filmed. When you come to Algeria, you can’t miss this beautiful botanical garden. #algeria #algiers #solotravel #moviescene #tarzan
